title: FalsegreenTestSpec
description: A language-neutral test specification used by the skill's authoring mode (Mode B). One spec is rendered into a non-false-green test in any supported stack (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Robot Framework).

level.description: Test pyramid level. Integration covers both API and database tests.

unit.description: What is under test: a function/method (unit), an endpoint or query (integration), or a page/flow (e2e).

scenario.description: The single behavior the test verifies, stated as one sentence.

arrange.description: Preconditions to set up before the action.

act.description: The call or interaction the test performs.

oracle.description: The independent source of the expected result. Must NOT be the current code output, or the test is a characterization test (false-green by construction).

source.description: Where the expected value comes from.

expected.description: The expected value or condition, derived from the source.

doubles.description: Boundaries replaced by a test double (unit/integration only). A real one of these inside a unit test is itself a smell.

languages.description: Target stacks to render the spec into. Omit to let the user choose.
